answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 35803 Country: India Title: How many money should be in my account to entitle me sahib-e-nisab? Question: How many money should be in my account to entitle me sahib-e-nisab? Answer ID: 35803 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 44/44/M=1433) By nisab if you mean the nisab of zakah then if you own the price of 52.5 tola silver beside debt and your main necessities then you will be considered as onwer of nisab. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
